map.食材成本 18 元、人工成本占比 20%、固定成本分摊 6 元、目标毛利率 65: Ingredient cost 18 CNY, labor share 20%, fixed cost allocation 6 CNY, target margin 65%: total cost = 18×(1+20%) + 6 = 27.60 CNY; recommended price = 27.60 ÷ (1-65%) = 78.86 CNY; gross profit per portion = 78.86 - 27.60 = 51.26 CNY. If the target margin drops to 60%, price = 27.60 ÷ 0.40 = 69.00 CNY, about 10 CNY cheaper but gross profit falls by 9.86 CNY.

map.固定成本怎么分摊？: How should fixed costs be allocated?
map.把房租、水电、折旧等月度固定支出除以预计月销量，得到每份应分摊的金额再填入。销量: Divide monthly fixed expenses such as rent, utilities and depreciation by the estimated monthly sales volume to get the amount allocated per portion, then enter that. The higher the estimated volume, the lower the per-portion allocation and the price, so estimate conservatively.
